clips.title: The story
paras: The Great Outdoors is an introductory quest offered by the outdoorsman Raan, who teaches novice adventurers the fundamentals of wilderness survival. By resting beside a basic campfire to gain Boosted Rest, wanderers learn essential campcraft before venturing toward nearby trade trainers to learn practical professions.

The Great Outdoors serves as an introductory lesson in surviving beyond the safety of settlement walls. Offered by an experienced wilderness traveler named Raan, the task reminds wandering adventurers that raw ambition and steel are useless without the practical campcraft needed to endure harsh elements. Raan welcomes aspiring wanderers into the ranks of restless souls seeking fortune and glory, offering practical guidance to those willing to learn.

The core requirement of the lesson is deceptively simple: taking a seat by Raan's basic campfire until the warmth grants the Boosted Rest effect. Out in the vast, untamed territories of Azeroth, knowing how to pause, set up camp, and recuperate can mean the difference between life and death. Once the basics of camping are mastered, Raan directs novices toward local village trainers to take up a trade and learn to craft specialized campsite fixtures.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, adventurer. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors is critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
